cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Challenge the captain's queue-jumping rule tonight. Put the rule first, please, not a speech about his personality.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He cancelled my booking last time I complained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then add 'restore my booking' as a separate request. Two numbered points. I'll make sure the wording is correct.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then sign it. I want him to know it's both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave a signature line for me. Once he accepts point one, call me up. Please don't submit an unfinished document with my name on it.

reason: Use professionally numbered requests and document correction to keep B exposed first, while the signature demand earns a concrete delay condition.
